meta.name: email-sequence
meta.description: When the user wants to create or optimize an email sequence, drip campaign, automated email flow, or lifecycle email program. Also use when the user mentions "email sequence," "drip campaign," "nurture sequence," "onboarding emails," "welcome sequence," "re-engagement emails," "email automation," or "lifecycle emails." For in-app onboarding, see onboarding-cro.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建并优化邮件自动化序列
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要设计或改进邮件自动化流程
copy.tagline_en: Create and optimize email automation sequences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design or improve email automation flows

howto.what: Claude 会帮你设计邮件序列，包括欢迎、培育、再激活等类型。它会提供模板、时间安排、主题行建议，并指导每封邮件的目标和内容。
howto.when: 当你提到“邮件序列”、“滴灌营销”、“培育序列”、“欢迎序列”、“再激活邮件”、“邮件自动化”或“生命周期邮件”时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个欢迎新用户的邮件序列。
say.note: Claude 会提供欢迎序列模板和内容建议。

say.text: 设计一个针对流失用户的再激活邮件序列。
say.note: Claude 会给出再激活序列的结构和文案思路。

say.text: 优化我的培育序列，提高转化率。
say.note: Claude 会分析现有序列并提出改进建议。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you design email sequences including welcome, nurture, re-engagement, etc. It provides templates, timing, subject line tips, and guides each email's goal and content.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "email sequence," "drip campaign," "nurture sequence," "onboarding emails," "welcome sequence," "re-engagement emails," "email automation," or "lifecycle emails."

say_en.text: Create a welcome email sequence for new users.
say_en.note: Claude provides welcome sequence template and content suggestions.

say_en.text: Design a re-engagement sequence for inactive users.
say_en.note: Claude gives structure and copy ideas for re-engagement.

say_en.text: Optimize my nurture sequence to improve conversion.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes current sequence and suggests improvements.
